ti.title: ንስምኪ ዝጸውዑ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ብኪዳንኪ ብዙሓት ድኂኖም
ብምልጃኺ ጽድቂ ረኺቦም’ዮም
ሕያውነት ኣምላኽ ጥዒሞም (2)
[[/chorus]]

ንስምኪ ዝጸውዑ ብእምነት
ኣምሊጦም’ዮም ሓዊ እሳት
ኣደ ጐይታ ማርያም ቅድስት ንጽህት

ባሕሪ ሓዊ በኣኺ ሰገሩ
ንዲያብሎስ ብዓወት ሰዓሩ
ኣብ ላዕሊ ኣብ ሰማይ ከበሩ (2)

ንሕና’ውን ብኣኺ ንእመን
ክትማልዲ ዘወትር ንልምን
እነሆ ደቅኺ ንምሕጸን (2)

ti_ro.title: Nsmki zTsew'u
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Hyawnet amlakh timom (2)
[[/chorus]]

Nsmki ztsewu bmnet
Amlitom’yom hawi sat
Ade goyta maryam qdst ntsht
Bkidanki bzuhat dhinom
Bmljakhi tsdqi rekhibom’yom
Bahri hawi beakhi segeru
Ndiyablos bawet searu
Ab lali ab semay keberu (2)
Nefsom’wn ntsdqi wenina
Hywetom’wn bakhi dhina
Lemni nkolay nana (2)
Nhna’wn bakhi nmen
Ktmaldi zewetr nlmn
Neho deqkhi nmhtsen (2)
Mmenan tsdqi zhlnu
Ade amlakh zekrna yblu
Nab fqur wedkhi ymhlelu (2)
